rules: Physical side/portal descriptions are separate from door GPS, current liturgical access, campus routing and public venue approval; expressly exclude unrelated internal sepulchre doors and different hospital quiet chapel.

evidence.attested_fact: Striking richly ornamented historical church portal is on southwest side.
Photographed historic plaque stands near southwest corner of church and nearby entrance; plaque coordinates are not a door survey.
Church building polygon center is known, not which polygon vertex contains public access.

reviews.architectural_entry_description: Southwest church portal: richly carved double doors with figures of Saints Augustine and Francis de Sales.
reviews.narrative_routing_instruction: Use the photographed ornate southwest portal as a *visual identification clue* at St Augustinus Schulkirche, not the adjacent school access.
reviews.next_editorial_gate: Obtain geolocated door point or operator floorplan for southwest portal and confirm it is open for FSSP Mass.

evidence.attested_fact: Monumental staircase ascends to main façade with central main portal.
During pandemic measures in May-July 2020, main portal was closed and side portal used exclusively.
Broad staircase leads to main church portal.

reviews.operator_access_description: Historic main façade/central portal accessed by monumental exterior staircase. Side portal explicitly used during a time-limited 2020 rule.
reviews.architectural_entry_description: Central main portal occupies stair-facing façade. Operational Mass door is not independently confirmed for 2026.
reviews.narrative_routing_instruction: Approach the church's main façade, not the monastery contact address; confirm current accessible door from sanctuary before issuing pedestrian routing.
reviews.next_editorial_gate: Find 2026 sanctuary instructions or plan identifying which church door is in use on recurring traditional-Mass dates.

evidence.attested_fact: Visitors enter St Peter and Paul through a Gothic portal, but no cardinal façade side or geographic point is provided.
Church object listed at Meringer Straße 2; FSSP had number 4.

reviews.architectural_entry_description: Historic Gothic portal mentioned by broadcaster. No reliable bearing or surveyed doorway.
reviews.narrative_routing_instruction: Do not treat Meringer Street 2 or 4 building centroid as a walk-to-door waypoint.
reviews.next_editorial_gate: Obtain sourced church-floorplan, geotagged frontal church façade, or operator visitor instructions.

evidence.attested_fact: The site is on Kapuzinergasse, a lane branching from Ostenstraße opposite the university.
Church daytime access is stated, no exterior entrance GPS or exact door orientation.
The regional tourism point locates the worship building, not its exterior entrance.

reviews.operator_access_description: Approach via Kapuzinergasse from Ostenstraße; the site is at Kapuzinergasse 2.
reviews.architectural_entry_description: No source in this pass locates the exterior church portal.
reviews.narrative_routing_instruction: Approach the Kapuzinergasse church building, then follow on-site signage to its entry; don't turn regional POI into exact door coordinates.
reviews.next_editorial_gate: Find a floorplan/photo of the outside church portal with a known street-facing orientation, or owner entrance instructions.

evidence.attested_fact: City lists St Leonhardskirche at Friedhofstraße 2.
Monument entry records cemetery chapel at Aalener Straße 2 within cemetery, with Friedhofstraße street reference.

reviews.architectural_entry_description: St Leonhard is within cemetery precinct; Friedhofstraße and Aalener Straße refer to distinct access/accounting conventions.
reviews.narrative_routing_instruction: Do not route to Aalener Straße 4, which is the different Herrgottsruhkapelle.
reviews.next_editorial_gate: Find city cemetery visitor access map and actual chapel door access.

evidence.attested_fact: Schlosskapelle is in former brewery in front part of Ringeisenhaus adjoining the Hohe Schloss, not within castle itself.
Ringeisenhaus former front brewery made into chapel in 1939 and consecrated in 1941.
OSM chapel location disagrees with alternate referenced positions by dozens of metres.

reviews.architectural_entry_description: Chapel occupies front former-brewery section of Ringeisenhaus, a separate building beside the Hohes Schloss.
reviews.narrative_routing_instruction: Do not route a Mass attendee to castle entrance or presumed OSM chapel door.
reviews.next_editorial_gate: Obtain municipality / chapel operator plan showing Ringeisenhaus front section and actual liturgical entrance; resolve map feature discrepancy.

evidence.attested_fact: St Josefs chapel has double-leaf historic entrance beneath gilded 'St Josephs Capelle' inscription and St Joseph statue with inscription.
Auferstehungskapelle or Raum der Stille is next to, not identical with, St Josefs Mass chapel.
Raum der Stille is a small chapel in hospital patient garden reached from cafeteria exit.
Vehicle campus entrance is Zimmerstraße 6; Allee nach Sanssouci 7 is drop-off to Haus St Josef and not campus through-route.

reviews.operator_access_description: Historic St Josef chapel address Allee nach Sanssouci 7; for campus/parking vehicles use Zimmerstraße 6. This is not the entrance to the distinct patient-garden Auferstehungskapelle.
reviews.architectural_entry_description: Historic two-leaf entrance under St Josephs Capelle gilded lettering and an arched St Joseph niche.
reviews.narrative_routing_instruction: Locate the historic chapel door using operator photograph or site plan; do not route Sunday Mass visitors to patient garden's Raum der Stille.
reviews.next_editorial_gate: Find true historic chapel building footprint/photographic georeference; retain verified alternative car access only.

excluded_wrong_target_objects.reason: Hospital explicitly identifies it as the OTHER chapel beside the St Josefs Mass chapel.
The active Schlosskapelle occupies the neighbouring Ringeisenhaus front brewery section, not castle.
A different chapel from St Leonhard cemetery church.
The doors lead into the architectural Holy Sepulchre INSIDE the church; they are not its exterior entrance.
Monastery operator contact does not prove church's operational liturgical entrance.
